source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: Frappe Drive is a Vue SPA whose router opens pages such as Folder.vue, which call the Python APIs in drive/api. These read and write the permissions and teams doctypes, while socket.js receives real-time updates.
